name: Bounding Wall Contour Overlay
aliases: Overlay Reference Field as Contours on Bounding Walls
Reference Field Contours on Bounding Walls
definition: A visualization technique to display a reference scalar field (e.g., b) as line contours on the vertical bounding walls of a 3D volume, providing context for deformed interfaces without occluding the primary data.
summary: Bounding Wall Contour Overlay projects 2D reference field contours onto 3D volume walls, providing spatial context without occluding primary data.
